title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
description: An overworked 24-year-old finally decides to live a little and create a bucket list, when a zombie outbreak hits the country.

episodes.title: S1-E8Sushi & Hot Springs of the Dead

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Akira Tendo is an overworked and broken man. But one day, a sudden zombie pandemic flips his world upside down, resulting in a life-changing revelation.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Determined to make up for all his lost vacation days, Akira goes into super lazy mode — until he has to brave the zombified streets to get more beer.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: After finding out that his old rugby buddy from college is in danger, Akira rushes over to Shinjuku to try and save him.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Akira and Kencho flee into the basement of a department store and meet a trio of flight attendants — checking one more item off the bucket list.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Remembering his childhood dream, Akira goes into the aquarium to grab a certain item, only to run into a group of survivors running for their lives.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Akira leaves Tokyo behind and heads back to his hometown, Gunma. When he makes a pit stop to get an RV, he reunites with Shizuka.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Akira finds himself sucked right back into his old, corporate drone mindset. Seeing him in that state triggers bad memories for Shizuka.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Akira and his friends meet a German college student who isn't going to let a zombie outbreak stop her from chasing her dreams.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Forced to take a detour through the forest, Akira gets very excited when he comes across a man building himself a treehouse.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Akira and the others settle in, helping out the villagers and their fellow refugees from Tokyo. But an old friend becomes consumed with revenge.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: With a massive zombie horde coming their way, Akira and the others split up to try and save the villagers, only to find themselves facing another threat.

episodes_data.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Faced with an impossible choice, Akira's time may have finally run out. And he hasn't even finished his bucket list yet!
